program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (define (side-count obj)
      (+ (if (= (obj-r1 obj) 0) 1 0)
         (if (= (obj-r2 obj) (- h 1)) 1 0)
         (if (= (obj-c1 obj) 0) 1 0)
         (if (= (obj-c2 obj) (- w 1)) 1 0)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 4) (= (side-count o) 2))) (objects g 0))])
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 8))))
